description: Small daily bootstrap stack defining Tier 0 session kernel, Tier 1 group routing, and Tier 2 specialist prompt payload without loading the whole prompt library. Includes startup-visible CODE_MODULE_HARD_MAX_500_LINES and CODE_MODULE_QUALITY_CANON_V1 bridges: ideal <=400, maximum <=500, PEP 8/SOLID/DRY canonical, and helper decomposition required instead of compressed formatting, plus durable generated-document and validation-evidence routing from disposable daily-work into the selected project support root.
notes: Startup Code Module Size Hard Gate Bridge v1 is mandatory beginning-of-chat context: every new or touched code/source module must be <=500 physical lines after creation, update, modification, refactor, or split; route over-limit code work to large_module_refactor_protocol before delivery.

Box Logic Startup Shield v1 is mandatory beginning-of-chat context: identify the active box, owner paths, allowed files, out-of-scope files, cross-box touches, public contracts, validation scope, and boundary risks before implementation, repair, refactor, prompt update, governance update, bundle, GUI, validation, freeze, patch, or artifact delivery.

Terminal Cleanup Contract Bridge v1 is mandatory beginning-of-chat context: install success uses about 2 seconds then Clear-Host and all non-install-success terminal blocks use Enter, Enter, one final Clear-Host; route emitted terminal commands to terminal_cleanup_contract and pre_output_contract_gates.

Code Module Quality Canon v1 is mandatory beginning-of-chat context: measure Python line counts after PEP 8 formatting; preserve SOLID and DRY; never compress formatting or duplicate logic to fit the maximum; create cohesive helpers instead.

Durable Documentation Artifact Routing Canon v1 is mandatory beginning-of-chat context: daily-work is transient; generated project-specific .txt/.md artifacts and successful validation evidence must persist under the selected project's sibling _show_project_to_AI support root.
